data.description: Winner of 3 Tony Awards and 4 Drama Desk Awards, Lend Me A Tenor is set in September 1934. Saunders, the general manager of the Cleveland Grand Opera Company, is primed to welcome world famous, Tito Morelli, Il Stupendo, the greatest tenor of his generation, to appear for one night only as Otello. The star arrives late and, through a hilarious series of mishaps, is given a double dose of tranquilizers and passes out. His pulse is so low that Saunders and his assistant Max believe he’s dead. In a frantic attempt to salvage the evening, Saunders persuades Max to get into Morelli's Otello costume and fool the audience into thinking he's Il Stupendo. Max succeeds admirably, but Morelli comes to and gets into his other costume ready to perform. Now two Otellos are running around in costume and two women are running around in lingerie, each thinking she is with Il Stupendo. A sensation on Broadway and in London's West End, this madcap, screwball comedy is guaranteed to leave audiences teary-eyed with laughter
data.location: Orlando Repertory Theatre (The Tupperware Theatre),1001 E. Princeton Street,Orlando,Florida,United States
data.name: Lend Me A Tenor

data.description:
This year, what happens at Bark stays at Bark! Join Animal Friends, with DVE’s Jimmy Krenn and DelMonte Pet Products, at Bark in the Park on Sunday, August 23 at 9am at North Park’s South Ridge Loop. 

Bring the whole family—especially the pooch!—for the biggest and best dog party of the year. Fetch pledges and walk in honor or in memory of a pet on the 1.5-mile Humane Hike. Then head back to the “Strip” for tons of fun: 

 Hit the Vegas Strip and shop ‘till you drop at the vendor tables.
 Cool down at the Bellagio water station.
 Stop by the Wedding Chapel to meet your match (hopeful adoptable animals await!).
 Swoon to croons from our Elvis impersonator 
 Pose for a memento photo.
 If your dog was adopted from Hotel de la Animal Friends, come see us at the “Players’ Club!”  
 Take a gamble on the Texas Hold ‘Em Walk. 
 Pamper your pooch at the Canine Ranch Spa with relaxing massages, paw-dicures and cold water spritzes! 
 Enjoy Chinese raffles, food, games and more! 

Registration opens at 9:00 am; the walk starts at 10:00am. Registration donations vary:

 Age 16 and up: $30 (receive a t-shirt and goody bag) 
 Age 16 and up: $25 (receive a goody bag only). 
 Kids 15 and under: free! (or with a t-shirt for $5). 

Go to www.thinkingoutsidethecage.org to register!!!!!

data.name: Bark in the Park
